channel.title: Feiyang Liu · Writing
channel.description: Columns, systems engineering notes, and bilingual essays on multimodal foundation models and LLM architectures by Feiyang Liu.

item.title: LLM 架构笔记（01）：Transformer 基础、现代组件与位置编码演进
item.description: 面向初学者的现代大模型底层架构笔记：结合手算例子与图解拆解 Transformer 并行、MHA/FFN、RMSNorm、SwiGLU、GQA、RoPE 副作用及 Kimi K3 的 NoPE 与 KDA。

item.title: TPU-RTX: Native Ray Tracing and Physical AI Rendering on Google TPU
item.description: Running Wide-BVH-64 ray tracing, 3DGS/4DGS, OpenUSD/Blender compilation, and differentiable physics in a single zero-copy XLA graph across 1–32 TPU v5p chips (3.06 TB HBM).

item.title: 0.6B模型能解决千禧年难题吗？ / Can a 0.6B Model Solve the Millennium Prize?
item.description: Language models that draw in pixels and video as plain text, and why symbolic visual data might be a better pretraining signal than images.

item.title: 3D更应该定位为交互手段而非通用智能 / 3D as an Interaction Interface Rather Than General Intelligence
item.description: Why 3D may disappear from inside the model, only to reappear outside the model as interactive environments, structured states, and control interfaces bridging language agents and the physical world.

item.title: 警惕 Vision Centric / Rethinking Vision-Centricity
item.description: Why vision in multimodal understanding behaves almost like another text, why encoder-free and language-centric paradigms are rising, and why visual generators are controllable renderers rather than logical planners.

item.title: Vision之外 / Beyond Vision
item.description: Do ego and taste still matter for newcomers in AI research, and should one stay in academia or move to industry?
